0.73365 Sarah Sharp (The Watercress Lady) at Pinnock Bridge https://www.london-walking-tours.co.uk/free-tours/haunted-pluckley.htm An elderly watercress seller—later identified as Sarah Sharp—accidentally set her clothes alight near a bridge and was found burned to death by the roadside in 1911. Local lore claims that on the anniversary of her death her ghost reappears
column3: wrapped in flames and screaming for help.

column2: 0.75098 The hanging Schoolmaster https://www.uwe.ac.uk/news/research-uncovers-truth-about-pluckleys-ghosts Actually a papermaker Henry Edgar Martin who died in the same way ascribed to the schoolmaster - ‘strangulation by hanging by a halter from a tree’.
